levels.name: Platform level (spor 1–4, two island platforms under the terminal)
levels.note: Bane NOR Sportabell: platform 'dekker spor 1 og 2' (360 m, 760 mm, 12 m wide) and platform 'dekker spor 4 og 3' (360 m, 760 mm, 12 m wide); a 250 m section by spor 2/3 is 8 m wide. Spor 1 northbound regional/local trains, spor 2 arriving Flytoget, spor 3 departing Flytoget (Oslo S/Drammen), spor 4 southbound. Flytoget says its trains to the city always leave from track 3. The station lies directly below the airport terminal (Wikipedia). OSM extract has no platforms or levels here.
levels._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-o-/oslo-lufthavn/, read 2026-10-30; Flytoget, "Train from Oslo Airport to the city" https://flytoget.no/en/to-and-from-airport/train-from-oslo-airport-to-city/, read 2026-10-30; Wikipedia, "Oslo Airport Station" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oslo_Airport_Station, read 2026-10-30

answers.question: (no open-question list for Norway; brief asks which Avinor shops are in or directly at the station area)
answers.answer: The station lies directly under the terminal; escalators, lifts and stairs lead one floor up into the arrivals floor (Ankomst), through Flytoget's ticket gates. Included as 'directly at the station area': the outlets Avinor places in Ankomstområdet / Ankomsthallen (landside arrivals): Narvesen ankomst innland and utland, Burger King, Joe & The Juice, Oslo Food Hub, Asia Street Cooking, Peppes Pizza, Ritazza, Vitusapotek, Loomis; plus Narvesen 'Gardermoen jbst.' (Narvesen's own list). Excluded: Tax Free (ankomst) and the vending machine in Bagasjehallen (baggage reclaim, airside), everything in Innsjekkingsområdet/Avgangshallen (departures floor: Starbucks, Parken, Point Kiosk, Samsonite & TUMI) and all gate-area outlets.
answers._source: Avinor, Oslo lufthavn "Shopping og mat" https://www.avinor.no/flyplass/oslo/shopping-og-mat/, read 2026-10-30; Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-o-/oslo-lufthavn/, read 2026-10-30; Flytoget, "Train from Oslo Airport to the city" https://flytoget.no/en/to-and-from-airport/train-from-oslo-airport-to-city/, read 2026-10-30; Wikipedia, "Oslo Airport Station" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oslo_Airport_Station, read 2026-10-30

open: Hours: Avinor gives only 'Åpent når det er flygninger' for all arrivals-area food/kiosk outlets (Narvesen x2, Burger King, Joe & The Juice, Oslo Food Hub, Asia Street Cooking, Peppes Pizza, Ritazza); no per-day hours from Avinor or the chains. Narvesen store finder hours did not render.

Exact positions of the arrivals-area outlets (left/right of the station escalators, domestic vs international hall, landside vs airside for 'Narvesen ankomst utland', 'Joe & The Juice', 'Oslo Food Hub', 'Asia Street Cooking') are not given in text; Avinor's arrivals map image could not be fetched.

Whether there is a separate station hall level between the platforms and the arrivals floor, and its signposted name: Bane NOR mentions a 'stasjonshall' (waiting room 24/7) but no source places it. Heights not measured in any source.

Number and position of lifts and escalators (which platform each serves) unknown: owner text confirms they exist; the OSM extract has no platforms, lifts or escalators for this station (only two footbridges w34082003, w661039552 and stairs w34081867 outside, unrelated to platforms).
Position of the ticket office (Billettsalg) and toilets relative to the station not given.

Wikipedia says outer platforms 1 and 4 serve Vy/SJ and inner platforms 2 and 3 serve Flytoget; Bane NOR's Sportabell shows two island platforms covering spor 1+2 and spor 3+4. The Bane NOR layout is used here.
OSM has no entrances for the station; the only entrance used is the arrivals-hall connection from owner text.
